\begin{tikzpicture}
      \begin{axis}[width=\textwidth,height=5cm,axis lines=middle,
        xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$},xmin=-0.2,xmax=1.4,ymin=-0.2,ymax=1.4,
        xtick={1},ytick={1}]
        \addplot[thick,blue,domain=0:1,samples=40,name path=P]{x^2};
        \addplot[thick,red,domain=0:1,samples=2,name path=L]{x};
        \addplot[green!40!black!25] fill between[of=L and P];
        \node[blue,font=\small] at (axis cs:1.15,0.85) {$y=x^2$};
        \node[red,font=\small] at (axis cs:0.35,0.65) {$y=x$};
      \end{axis}
    \end{tikzpicture}
